Saransh Jain earns maiden Test call-up for Sri Lanka series

Off-spinner Saransh Jain has received his maiden Test call-up for India's upcoming series against Sri Lanka. The squad, led by Shubman Gill, also includes Jasprit Bumrah, who is awaiting fitness clearance. Jain has credited his family and discipline for his selection, describing it as a "dream-come-true" moment. Bumrah missed the third ODI against England due to an "impact injury" but appeared sharp in his previous matches.
